Description:
Experience contemporary elegance and urban convenience in this luxurious 3-bedroom, 3-bathroom flat located in the prestigious Laurel Heights District. Thoughtfully designed to blend modern living with refined details, this home offers a spacious open floor plan featuring stunning hardwood floors with radiant heating, custom built-in storage, and a cozy gas fireplace. The living and dining areas flow effortlessly into the designer kitchen, which boasts solid slab quartz countertops, a full backsplash, and top-of-the-line Liebherr and Bosch appliances—making it perfect for both everyday cooking and entertaining.
The three well-appointed bedrooms are tucked at the rear of the home for added privacy, with two overlooking a serene, shared garden oasis. Each bedroom is a private suite, offering comfort and seclusion. Two of the suites open directly onto a peaceful garden-view deck. Designer touches abound, from the large plank bleached oak hardwood floors to the floor-to-ceiling Fleetwood windows that flood the space with natural light. The soaring ceilings enhance the airy, open feel of the home.
Smart home features elevate modern living, with wired internet throughout, surround sound, in-unit laundry, and easy access to the shared Zen Garden—your tranquil escape from the bustle of the city. A garage parking space for one small vehicle is included.
Ideally located with a 94 Walk Score, this home is just steps from the best of Laurel Village, including shopping, dining, and multiple grocery options. The Presidio and UCSF are also nearby, offering exceptional convenience. This newly built, luxurious residence is truly a rare gem in one of San Francisco's most sought-after neighborhoods.
